svg.aria-label: Proposition 40 passage odds on Kalshi and Polymarket from October 2025 to October 2026, and a scatter of daily changes in the odds against daily changes in the California-minus-national municipal bond fund spread, with fitted slopes near zero and a dashed reference line for an effect near the detection floor
svg.text: Chance of passage, 4 p.m. Eastern close
Each trading day: change in the odds
A tilted line would mean the spread moved with
the odds. Dashed: a 6 bp effect per full swing,
near the smallest the test detects.
Change in the odds, percentage points
Fitted slope for a move from 0% to 100%:
Sources: Kalshi and Polymarket APIs; fund prices from Yahoo Finance.
Spread change = MUB-minus-CMF daily return difference / CMF's
7.08-year duration. Positive: California's yields rose against the nation's.
The test catches 5 to 7 bp per full swing four times in five.
